_comment: 2016 JetHT counterpart of dijet_data_2018_rho_skim.json (JetHT Run2016F(-UL2016), G, H (postVFP), 147 files). Data fills only the `reco` table plus events/alljets; `matched`/`gen` are booked but stay empty, and for data final_seq == recoTot_seq so `reco` means the same thing as in MC. Mode `rho_skim10` matches the MC prescale for this channel so data/MC compare bin-for-bin. Run via `python scripts/run_dijet_skim_split.py --config <this> --bins Run2016F-UL2016 Run2016G Run2016H` -- one submit per run era for the same client-reduce reason as the MC HT split. Era plumbing for 2016: JEC Summer19UL16_V7_MC / Summer19UL16_RunFGH_V7_DATA, JER Summer20UL16_JRV3_MC, lumi 16.8 fb^-1, golden JSON Cert_271036-284044_13TeV_Legacy2016_Collisions16_JSON.txt, prescales/ps_weight_JSON_2016.json. The fileset qualifier that selects this era's datasets is set by notebook_utils.HADRONIC_ERAS_DATA; the processor re-derives the same IOV from the DAS name, so nothing here needs an explicit IOV key.
